articles.title_en: Finland and Norway plan to bar entry to Russian athletes as long as the war in Ukraine continues
articles.lead_en: Norway’s Ministry of Justice and Public Security will instruct the Directorate of Immigration and the National Police Directorate to deny entry to Russian and Belarusian athletes traveling to the country for competitions, the government said. The restrictions will also apply to support staff.

articles.title_en: Russian court upholds 11-year prison sentence for opposition politician Lev Shlosberg
articles.lead_en: The Pskov Regional Court has upheld the sentence handed to Lev Shlosberg, the deputy chair of the Yabloko party, on a repeat charge of “discrediting” the Russian army and spreading “false information” about the military, the independent outlet Mediazona reported.

articles.title_en: Putin wants to repeat the Oleshky humanitarian mission in occupied Kostiantynivka. Why there? And is it a ploy to resupply Russian troops?
articles.lead_en: Ahead of his meeting with U.S. presidential envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, Russian President Vladimir Putin proposed a humanitarian operation in Kostiantynivka, in Ukraine’s Donetsk region, modeled on a similar mission recently carried out in Oleshky.
